name: VectorCraft v0.10.0
body:
## What's Changed
* #1063: a fill or stroke chosen with characters selected colours just them by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1075
* Fix font size and horizontal scale after text/group scaling by @lollinoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1045

* Object: Align, Move, Arrange and other commands that change nothing record no undo step by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1060
* #1032: spot colours defined in Lab keep their Lab values by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1076
* Build: generated sources are rewritten only when they change by @bobtherobot in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1051
* Gradient mesh: a fill colour recolours the point last clicked (#1050) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1052
* fix(ui): keep All Tools drawer compact on wide screens by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1054
* fix(textwrap): reject malformed explicit object targets atomically by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1055
* fix(gradient): reject malformed freeform line index lists by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1056
* fix(corners): reject malformed explicit dialog targets by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1057
* fix(views): validate saved-view coordinates and rotation by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1058
* Tests: the command sweeps no longer skip junk scale, spacing and artboard values by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1059
* EPS: arc and arcn with huge angles no longer hang the import by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1062
* Align: a compound path or selected group that contains the key object stays in place by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1074
* #1068: a .ai read as its PDF part keeps its artboard layout by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1084
* fix(layers): validate explicit Layer Options targets by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1077
* fix(shaper): reject invalid explicit scribble targets by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1078
* fix(width): validate every explicit width-point removal index by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1079
* fix(ui): show Preferences checkbox outlines in every theme by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1080
* Adopt shared docking with panel menus and saved return locations by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1090
* #885: every checkbox keeps a visible box at rest by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1112
* Width points: set and copy refuse a malformed index by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1113
* #1102: an EPS keeps its page and stacked text strokes through its layers by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1120
* #1085: the DMG's app passes codesign --strict by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1121
* Drops: libraries, presets and plug-ins open on a drop, as File › Open opens them by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1083
* Align: a key object needs two or more selected objects by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1088
* Align: Align to Artboard uses the active artboard by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1105
* Align, Reflect and Shear: object.align needs a direction; unknown choices are errors by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1106
* MCP: object.setProps removes the objects it hides or locks from the selection by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1107
* Part of #394: Align and Distribute move pattern tiles when Transform Pattern Tiles is on by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1108

* #1111: Ctrl+Shift+L, C, R, J and F align paragraphs by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1127
* Fix #867: macOS file dialogs are sheets, and no dialog runs inside the event handler by @Emlembow in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1099
* #893: Shape Builder merges leave no seams on grids of lines by @NoJuanNobody in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1081
* Type: Proportional Metrics in vertical type — upright glyphs on the font's proportional heights, `vpal` (#966) by @imachus in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1082
* Plug-ins: whole-number parameters keep their exact value and stay in range by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1091
* PDF/.ai import: glyphs spaced each their own way keep their place by @p0lyg0n in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1101

* Part of #812: Ctrl/Cmd and Alt shape a star while it's dragged by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1146
* #1018: Edit Toolbar opens a drawer beside the toolbar; tools drag in and out by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1149
* Icons: the Selection arrow is black and Direct Selection's white in every theme by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1150

* #1144: Live Corners round corners between curved segments too by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1159
* #1133: Zig Zag's dialog has sliders and radio buttons, as in Illustrator by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1160

* #1111: a blend's spine bends into a curve by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1174
* #1158: Alt-click on a layer's eye or lock isolates that layer by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1175

* #1163: MCP render_preview takes an artboard index by @bflatastic in https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/pull/1177
